univom.machine.fission_reactor.tooltip.0: §7A device that releases high-density thermal energy via nuclear fission
univom.machine.fission_reactor.tooltip.1: The Fission Reactor is governed by three parameters: Fuel Rods, Control Rods and Coolant
univom.machine.fission_reactor.tooltip.3: Fuel rods must be placed in the §aFuel Rod Input Bus
univom.machine.fission_reactor.tooltip.4: The rate of core temperature increase is affected by the base heat output of the fuel rods
univom.machine.fission_reactor.tooltip.5: Different fuel rods have varying base heat outputs and durabilities
univom.machine.fission_reactor.tooltip.7: Control Rods must be placed in the §aControl Rod Insert Bus
univom.machine.fission_reactor.tooltip.8: Different control rods provide varying absorption efficiency
univom.machine.fission_reactor.tooltip.9: Control rod insertion rates must be configured in the §aControl Rod Insert Bus
univom.machine.fission_reactor.tooltip.1: The reactor accepts three types of coolant, each with a different Heat Capacity Factor
The reactor consumes input coolant and outputs overheated coolant
Temp Increment = (Net Heat Production - Total Heat Dissipation) / 50
50 is the constant heat capacity of the core. Every §c50HU§r of accumulated net heat increases the core temperature by §c1K§r
§bNet Heat = Base Heat Output * (1 - (Insertion Rate * Absorption Efficiency))
univom.machine.fission_reactor.tooltip.2: Active Cooling = Actual Coolant Usage * Heat Capacity Factor
Actual Usage = Math.min(Max Flow Rate, Math.ceil((Net Heat + (Core Temperature - 400) * 50) / Heat Capacity Factor))
Active cooling begins when temperature exceeds §4400 K§r
Core temperature exceeding §42500 K§r will result in a meltdown

univom.machine.oxygen_distributor.toolti: §7Consumes stored oxygen to keep a sealed space breathable
§7Supply range: a cube extending §b%s§7 blocks in every direction from the machine
§7Uses §e%s EU/t§7 and §b%s mB/t§7 of oxygen while running
§cOnly works inside a fully sealed space within its range, and cuts off the oxygen the moment it stops running
§cThe front face must stay completely unobstructed
§7Processes items in high-pressure gas from a pressure network
Hollow cube with an edge of §e%s~%s§r blocks; the interior must be all air
Needs §e1§r Pressure Port connected to a pressure network; each interior block adds §e%s L§r of volume
Rated Pressure grows with size: 3³ §e%s§r / 4³ §e%s§r / 5³ §e%s§r / 6³ §e%s§r / 7³ §e%s§r bar; the network explodes once it reaches the rating
Each batch loses §e%s L§r of network gas through the airlock
Parallels grow with the interior size and the pressure above the recipe requirement, up to Rated Pressure × interior blocks
Breaking the structure vents the whole network
